question: Can sharp-|C_t| anchoring deliver q within ~1-3 deg on fast tumblers, and does the joint LM polish bridge the residual gap under truth vs realistic-blind omega seeds?
hypothesis: Anchor delivery is the blocker; if anchoring reaches the s084 1-3 deg q budget and the polish converges, the v3 pipeline is gated open.
narrative_md: Anchor delivery is NOT the blocker: sharp-|C_t| coarse-find then dense-resample delivers fast-seed q to 1.65-3.30 deg @400k (119 tightens to 1.56 @800k), within the s084 1-3 deg budget (Layer A blind, truth as comparison target only). With truth omega (L0) the joint polish is rock-solid (3/3 Band A every perturbation); with a realistic blind omega (L1: dir 1.5 deg, |omega| 0.5%) fast seed 119 fails (1/3, rho~25), the small omega error amplifying into 12-20 deg q0 error through 738 deg back-propagation. The bottleneck moved upstream to the blind omega estimate. Layer B perturbs truth-q and seeds omega relative to truth -> oracle_clean false.
